snippet.title: Memories in Motion —a new Pokémon GO Season is here!
snippet.description:
Memories in Motion—a new Pokémon GO Season is here!

Trainers, what memories await in your future adventures?

The new Season runs from March 3, 2026 to June 2, 2026!

https://pokemongo.com/seasons/memories-in-motion
